verdict.rationale: Aider provides AI-generated insights about the user's codebase via `/ask` (questions without editing), `/map` (repo structure), and its repo-map feature summarizing key classes/functions, and community reports confirm it explains and navigates unfamiliar codebases effectively, faster than manual search. Missing for 10: proactive/unprompted insight generation (it's ask-driven only) and insight generation over non-code data sources.
